mapper.select: SELECT no, district, title, address, phone FROM travel WHERE district = CONVERT(#{district} USING utf8mb4) ORDER BY title ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel WHERE district = CONVERT(#{district} USING utf8mb4)
mapper.insert: insert into travel (district, title, description, address, phone) values(#{district}, #{title},#{description},#{address}, #{phone})
